span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Raising correlations redistributes noise power out of the high-frequency Fourier components, and because heterogeneous tuning spreads the stimulus signal into exactly those components, their signal-to-noise ratio rises
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Heterogeneous tuning distributes the encoded signal across all spatial frequencies, so the high-frequency channels favoured by strong correlations carry stimulus information
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Attention improves coding by suppressing a shared noise source (raising rates, lowering Fano factors and correlations together), which lowers noise entropy, rather than by decorrelation per se
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: raising correlations moves noise power into a few low-frequency Fourier components and removes it from all the higher ones; a homogeneous population encodes only in the low frequencies and is hurt, a heterogeneous one encodes across all frequencies and is helped
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the two effects compete, which is why the dependence on correlation is non-monotonic and why the high frequencies win as the population grows
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: underneath it, correlating neurons at fixed marginal variances lowers the noise entropy, and lower noise entropy shrinks the variance in most directions
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: but lower entropy alone is not enough - it helps only because a heterogeneous population spreads its signal across all the directions the entropy reduction touches
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Whether noise entropy is equally decisive for scenarios not modelled here (stimulus-dependent or heterogeneous correlations, multi-dimensional stimuli) is untested.
span.note: what this limits: the noise-entropy conclusion outside the modelled cases: whether it holds FOR OTHER SCENARIOS NOT CONSIDERED EXPLICITLY IN THIS STUDY - STIMULUS-DEPENDENT AND HETEROGENEOUS CORRELATIONS, OR SIMULTANEOUS ENCODING OF MULTIPLE STIMULUS DIMENSIONS - REMAINS TO BE INVESTIGATED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The reconciliation with experiments reporting reduced correlations was not worked out in detail against those studies' actual parameters.
span.note: what this limits: the reconciliation with the experiments reporting reduced correlations: WE DID NOT ASSESS THIS IN DETAIL BY TAKING INTO ACCOUNT ALL RELEVANT PARAMETERS FROM THESE STUDIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Results assume an optimal readout; computationally constrained (e.g. linear) readouts can behave differently.
span.note: what this limits: every result about what correlations do to a code: OF COURSE, THE EFFECT OF CORRELATIONS CAN BE DIFFERENT FOR OTHER, COMPUTATIONALLY CONSTRAINED READOUTS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the model itself stops being valid past a critical population size once correlation coefficients are made variable, because the covariance matrix loses positive definiteness
span.note: what this limits: the large-population regime the paper is about: THE COVARIANCE MATRIX WILL BE VALID (POSITIVE DEFINITE) ONLY UP TO n ~ 1/(2 sigma)^2 ... FROM A CRITICAL n ON, THE MODEL WILL NOT BE VALID ANY MORE

span.label: correlations → variances
span.note: THE TWO CANNOT BE SEPARATED IN THIS STUDY - the DESIGN form (Q-286/Q-287). It bounds what the paper's own results can mean, and it lives in a methods paragraph where nothing downstream will find it. And the span adds the part that matters for interpretation: 'neither of both is more important than the other' - the authors decline to rank the two causes they cannot separate.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE FIELD'S CONCLUSION WAS A PROPERTY OF ITS SIMPLIFYING ASSUMPTION: most previous studies use HOMOGENEOUS population models in which neurons differ only in preferred stimulus, and heterogeneity CRITICALLY ALTERS the properties of a population code - 'this has not been sufficiently appreciated'
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the belief stated in the form it is usually held - if correlations are unavoidable, Quotation withheld, which is why falling correlations under attention, adaptation and learning are read as better coding
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND THE ANSWER REVERSES: in populations with more than a few hundred neurons, INCREASING limited-range correlations can substantially IMPROVE encoding accuracy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: PUBLISHED PAPERS DISAGREE AND THE PARAMETER THEIR DISAGREEMENT TURNS ON IS NAMED: 'The apparent discrepancy arises from SUBTLE DIFFERENCES IN THE ASSUMPTIONS that were made about the population activity, such as for instance the noise model (additive vs Poisson-like)'
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the two conditions are stated exactly: the information saturates ONLY IF the variances do not depend on the stimulus AND all neurons have identical tuning curves - fail either and it grows linearly
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A FREE PARAMETER THAT SHOULD NEVER HAVE BEEN FREE: the level of correlations cannot be optimized on its own with tuning functions and variances held fixed, because that drives the model to a DEGENERATE, biologically implausible solution
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: stated against its own model too - MOST MODELS USED IN PREVIOUS STUDIES, INCLUDING OUR ABOVE MODEL, are not well constrained, because they permit the noise entropy to be made arbitrarily small
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: AND ONCE THE RIGHT THING IS HELD CONSTANT, THE QUANTITY THE WHOLE LITERATURE MEASURES DROPS OUT: with noise entropy fixed, the information depends ONLY on amplitude variability and is INDEPENDENT of both the structure and the magnitude of correlations
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the conclusion drawn in the field's own terms - accuracy is set by the amount of heterogeneity and the overall noise entropy, and the specific noise structure is NOT AS IMPORTANT AS COMMONLY ASSUMED
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

THIS RECORD IS ALREADY THE CORPUS'S BEST CASE FOR IDEALISATION CHANGING A CONCLUSION, and this sentence is part of that argument rather than a definition. Found by the neighbour query (Q-400). Malformed rather than mis-grounded: no span can make a population the cause of its size. — status: the paper's own words: we did not assess · strength of the relation: 0.9 — not assessed in detail, by the paper's own admission - THE ESCAPE ROUTE IS TESTED AND REJECTED ON ITS OWN TERMS - it would need the read-out population to be at most a few hundred cells, which given a single cortical column seems RATHER UNLIKELY

THIS RECORD ALREADY CARRIES THE OTHER HALF OF THE SAME LESSON: its conclusion reverses when the homogeneity idealisation is dropped, and heterogeneous correlations are named right here as untested.
